# SheetWatch

> SheetWatch is a web application that monitors Google Sheets for cell-level changes. You connect a
> Google account, pick a spreadsheet, tab, and cell range, and SheetWatch polls that range on your
> chosen interval, diffs it against the previous reading, and notifies you by web push, email,
> Slack, Discord, Telegram, or a generic webhook.

Operated by Prem Raichura, an independent software developer based in India.
Contact: premraichura7@gmail.com

## Key facts

- **Pricing:** free to use as of 15 August 2026.
- **Detection model:** interval polling, not live Google events. A change that reverts between two
  polls is not detected.
- **Google OAuth scopes requested:** `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets` (restricted),
  `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive` (restricted), `email`, `profile`.
- **Data stored:** account email and Google ID, AES-256-GCM-encrypted OAuth tokens, watch
  configuration, and point-in-time snapshots of only the cell ranges the user selected.
- **Data never used for:** selling, advertising, data brokerage, or training generalized AI or
  machine learning models.
- **Cookies:** one strictly necessary signed session cookie (`sw_session`). No analytics, no
  advertising, no third-party tracking.
- **Writes to sheets:** only when a user explicitly accepts a cross-sheet suggestion, or removes a
  spreadsheet (which moves it to Google Drive trash).
- **Deletion:** self-serve in the app at Settings → Account → Danger zone, confirmed by typing the
  account email. Immediate and permanent; the Google grant is revoked as part of it. Email
  premraichura7@gmail.com as a fallback. Access can be revoked independently at
  https://myaccount.google.com/permissions.
- **Governing law:** India. Exclusive jurisdiction: courts of Gujarat, India.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://sheet-watch.vercel.app/privacy): OAuth scopes and their purpose, what
  Google user data is accessed and stored, the Google API Services Limited Use disclosure,
  subprocessors, retention periods, security measures, user rights, and account deletion.
- [Terms of Service](https://sheet-watch.vercel.app/terms): service description, eligibility, when
  SheetWatch writes to sheets, acceptable use, share links, availability limits, disclaimers,
  limitation of liability, termination, and governing law.
